question: Which deities are present in this locus, fair-faced goddess?
premises: The locus is indicated as here.
Brahmā is present in this locus.
Viṣṇu and Rudra are also present.
inference: Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra dwell together in this locus.
plain_english: Here, O fair-faced one, Brahmā, Viṣṇu, and Rudra indeed are present.
